Heidelberg Materials, formerly known as HeidelbergCement AG, stands as one of the world’s largest building materials companies. Founded in 1874 in Heidelberg, Germany, the company has evolved from a single cement plant to a global powerhouse in construction materials. Its strategic acquisitions have positioned it as the number one producer of aggregates, second-largest in cement, and third-largest in ready-mixed concrete globally. title: HeidelbergCement India - HeidelbergCement India is a German manufacturer with an experience of more than 150 years in cement manufacturing.
content:
Overview:
HeidelbergCement India – a part of Heidelberg Materials Group, Germany set its footprints in Indian market in 2006. With a legacy of 150+ years in the industry, we are committed to provide high quality products to our customers. Under the brand name Mycem Cement (www.mycemco.com) and Zuari Cement (www.zuaricements.com), we are steadily growing in the key markets of India. Heidelberg Materials is one of the world’s largest aggregator of building materials, operating with a vision of delivering sustainable and future-ready construction solutions. Globally, the group is leading the transition toward a carbon-neutral construction industry by 2070, and HeidelbergCement India is aligned with this mission. At the heart of our operations lies a strong focus on technological advancement and people development. We continuously invest in upgrading our systems and empowering our teams to stay ahead of the curve. We are also deeply committed to positively impacting the lives of those associated with construction — from masons and contractors to builders and architects. Backed by trusted German quality, we strive to bring innovative, reliable, and performance-driven products to the Indian market.

It is a DAX corporation and stands as one of the world's largest building materials companies. This acquisition made HeidelbergCement the number one producer of construction aggregates, the second-largest in cement and the third-largest in ready-mixed concrete worldwide. This deal made the combined company the second largest cement and building materials company in the world. On 1 July 2016, HeidelbergCement AG completed the acquisition of a 45% shareholding in Italcementi S.p.A.
